purpose: graded positive controls (split-half and cross-sample self-mapping) to bracket the correspondence metric from above, complementing the impossible-subtype floor
CAVEAT: Rung 1 is same-cells-same-assay and is therefore an upper bound no cross-dataset mapping can reach; it brackets the scale, it is not a pass mark. Scores are only comparable across runs with the same column count because the metric centres over the columns passed and selects its gene panel over them.
